description.zh:
返回值语言，取值：

- zh-CN：中文。

- en-US：英文。
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh-CN: Chinese
*   en-US: English

description.zh:
实例配置的付费类型：

- 预付费：prepay (传入空值默认是prepay)

- 后付费：postpay
用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。该参数值可自定义，但是要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can specify a custom value for this parameter, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh:
域名实例的启用状态：

- enable：启用状态，GTM实例智能调度策略生效；

- disable：禁用状态，GTM实例智能调度策略不可用；
description.en:
The enabling state of the access domain name. Valid values:

*   enable: The access domain name is enabled and the intelligent scheduling policy of the corresponding GTM instance takes effect.
*   disable: The access domain name is disabled and the intelligent scheduling policy of the corresponding GTM instance is unavailable.

description.zh: 全局流量管理3.0实例ID，唯一标识产品实例。
description.en: The ID of the Global Traffic Manager (GTM) 3.0 instance. This ID uniquely identifies a GTM 3.0 instance.
The description of the access domain name.
The hostname of the access domain name.

description.zh:
接入域名的解析记录类型：

- A：IPv4地址

- AAAA：IPv6地址

- CNAME：域名
description.en:
The type of the Domain Name System (DNS) record configured for the access domain name. Valid values:

*   A: IPv4 address
*   AAAA: IPv6 address
*   CNAME: domain name

description.zh:
接入域名配置模式：

- sys_assign：系统分配（此模式已不支持）

- custom：自定义，用户需选择实例所在账号下的域名进行关联，并输入主机记录以生成接入域名
description.en:
The configuration mode of the access domain name. Valid values:

*   sys_assign: system allocation. This mode is not supported.
*   custom: custom allocation. You must select a zone within the account to which the instance belongs and enter a hostname to generate an access domain name.

description.zh: zone名称，即GTM接入域名的父Zone。一般为GTM实例所在账号下，在云解析DNS控制台的托管域名，支持主域和子域。
description.en: The name of the parent zone for the access domain name configured in GTM. In most cases, the value of this parameter is the name of a zone hosted by Alibaba Cloud DNS. This zone belongs to the account to which the GTM instance belongs. You can specify the name of a zone or subzone.

description.zh: 全局TTL，单位是秒。接入域名解析到地址池中地址的TTL值，影响解析记录在运营商LocalDNS中的缓存时间，支持自定义TTL值。
description.en: The global time to live (TTL) period. Unit: seconds. The global TTL period affects how long the DNS records that map the access domain name to the addresses in the address pools are cached in the local DNS servers of Internet service providers (ISPs). You can specify a custom value.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns create-cloud-gtm-instance-config --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240022 --instance-id gtm-cn-jmp3qnw0003 --schedule-zone-mode custom --schedule-zone-name example.com --schedule-hostname www --schedule-rr-type A --ttl 30 --remark test --enable-status enable --charge-type postpay --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns CreateCloudGtmInstanceConfig --region cn-hangzhou --ScheduleRrType A --ScheduleZoneName 'example.com' --InstanceId 'gtm-cn-jmp3qnw0003' --EnableStatus enable --ChargeType postpay --ScheduleHostname www --AcceptLanguage 'en-US' --ScheduleZoneMode custom --ClientToken '1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240022' --Ttl 30 --Remark test
